[/Thinking]

In LaTeX, `\rowcolor` is used to color an entire row in a table.

### Basic usage
```latex
\rowcolor{yellow}
A & B & C \\
```

### Requirements
Add one of these packages in the preamble:

```latex
\usepackage[table]{xcolor}
```

or

```latex
\usepackage{colortbl}
```

### Example
```latex
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[table]{xcolor}

\begin{document}

\begin{tabular}{|l|l|l|}
\hline
\rowcolor{gray!30}
Name & Age & City \\
\hline
Alice & 23 & Paris \\
Bob & 31 & Rome \\
\hline
\end{tabular}

\end{document}
```

### Notes
- `\rowcolor` should be placed **before the row contents**.
- You can use any defined color, e.g. `red`, `blue!20`, `gray!50`.
- If you want to color individual cells, use `\cellcolor{...}` instead.

If you want, I can also show how to color alternating rows automatically.
